mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 5.3% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek safe-haven assets.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.3, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0) combined with weak housing starts (HOUST < 1000) signals a deepening recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic fears intensify.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0 AND HOUST < 1000, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion, defined by GDP growth above 3% and unemployment below 4.5%, signals overbought market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy approaches a peak.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth > 3% and UNRATE < 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 110, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High residential sales (RSAFS > 350000) signal strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy shows resilience and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 350000, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates central bank support during market stress.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 2.5, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 2% signals a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings and consumer spending support equity valuations.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth > 2%, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.
